Sprinter Van Rental Arizona: Your Complete Guide to Group Transportation

Renting a Sprinter van in Arizona costs $145 to $295 per hour depending on the cabin: the 14-seat Executive Sprinter at $145, the 13- and 16-seat Limo Party Sprinters at $175, the 15-seat Ultra Luxury Party Sprinter at $250, and the 9-seat Maybach Jet Sprinter at $295. An 8-hour wine country day in the Executive Sprinter bills 7 hours, $1,015, about $73 per person for 14.

The Mercedes Sprinter has changed group transportation. It is not a cramped shuttle and not an impersonal bus. It is just right for groups of 8 to 16 who want comfort, style, and practicality, and we own every one of ours.

Why Sprinters Dominate Arizona Group Travel

The Practical Advantages

Stand-up interior: passengers actually stand up inside. No hunched exits, no bumped heads.
Climate control that works: the cabin is cooled before pickup, and it stays cool in July.
Luggage room: golf clubs, wine cases, hiking gear, wedding attire.
Modern amenities: USB charging, premium sound, leather seating.
Maneuverability: Sprinters fit winery driveways, resort entrances, and Old Town valet lanes that buses cannot.

The Experience Advantages

Conversation: lounge configurations let the group actually talk.
Privacy: tinted windows and an enclosed cabin.
Flexibility: change the plan mid-trip. Sprinters are nimble.

Sprinter Van Configurations

Executive Sprinter and Executive White Sprinter

Seats: 14 · Rate: $145/hour · Minimum: 4 hours
Forward-facing leather captain's chairs, like a first-class cabin. Airport transfers, corporate shuttles, day trips, families. The Executive White Sprinter is the same cabin in white, popular for weddings.

Ultra Luxury Party Sprinter

Seats: 15 · Rate: $250/hour · Minimum: 4 hours
Our top party cabin: club lighting, sound, and finishes a step above the Limo Party Sprinters.

Maybach Jet Sprinter

Seats: 9 · Rate: $295/hour · Minimum: 4 hours
Jet-style luxury for executives, VIP guests, and couples who want the best vehicle in Arizona.

Wine Country Tours

Route: Phoenix to the Verde Valley and back · Duration: 8-10 hours · Sweet spot: 8-14 people

Room for wine purchases, comfort on the run up and back, easy winery parking, and nobody drives after tasting.

Sample itinerary: 9 AM pickup, 11 AM first winery, 12:30 PM lunch, 2 PM second winery, 3:30 PM third, 5 PM depart, 7 PM home.

Cost: 10 hours in the Executive Sprinter bills 9, $1,305, about $93 per person for 14 or about $131 for 10. See the Verde Valley wine country tour.

Airport Groups

Everyone and their luggage arrives together, with flight tracking.

Sprinter vs. Two or Three SUVs

One Sprinter keeps the group together, simplifies coordination, and usually costs less than three separate vehicles. Two Luxury SUVs for 6 hours are $1,500; one Executive Sprinter for 6 hours is $870.

Booking Tips for Arizona Sprinter Rentals

Lead Time

Availability varies by date and by vehicle. Request a current quote for your date and we will confirm what is open. Tell us the date, the headcount and the itinerary, and we will confirm which Sprinters are open and quote them. Paid online checkout closes 24 hours before pickup; inside that window, call our reservations team.

Questions to Ask Any Operator

  1. Is this the exact vehicle, or "similar"?
  2. What is included in the rate?
  3. What is the overtime rate?
  4. Is BYOB allowed, and what are the rules?
  5. Can we see it before booking?

Red Flags

  • Will not show the vehicle
  • Vague about configuration
  • No reviews or references
  • Cash-only payment

Drinking on Board

Passengers 21 and over can drink in a Sprinter. Arizona's open-container law exempts passengers in a vehicle for hire such as a party bus or limousine (A.R.S. § 4-251). BYOB, no underage drinking, and the driver never drinks. Read the full explainer.
